title: AMD buys Xilinx in $35B all-stock deal

sources.quote: AMD (NASDAQ: AMD) and Xilinx (NASDAQ: XLNX) today announced they have entered into a definitive agreement for AMD to acquire Xilinx in an all-stock transaction valued at $35 billion.

explain: AMD bought programmable-chip maker Xilinx, paying with AMD shares valued at $35B when announced; the deal closed in February 2022. It expanded AMD's data-center business ahead of its push into AI chips.
